notes.title: 16 November Major Update !!
notes.notes:
16 November Major Update !!
Hello everyone :) 
Today I have a new patch update that will change the look of Wanderjahr.
/ Adjust the game to be HD widescreen mode (1280 x 720p). 
/ Support controller control. (Suggest XBox360 controller and driver that support winmm.lib.)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11819182/8ad756a899e2c6c7da753083fecd89e6e93461e0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 12 July Update
notes.notes:
Hi :)
27 September Update
Adjust exp give when replay the stage while team level still not exceed suggest level. Also reduce some monster HP on stage 2 to make gameplay faster.


12 July Update
Fix some minor issues about text and GUI display.
Adjust level cap in some stages, make the game more challenging.


4 April Update 
Fix bug that sometimes using special attack will cause game freeze. 
Fix bug that sometimes using research skill by researcher will cause game freeze. 
Add some work around on issue that sometimes some antivirus program will block the game from starting.


16 Mar Update
Improve English translation in all parts of the game. 
Adjust some balance in stage1 to make game play smoother.
